episode.tagline: Imagine a world without maps. What is out there? How do you reach that place? What does the world look like?
episode.about: In this episode, Ajay and Amit speak about the evolution of maps, from the laborious survey work pioneered by the legendary George Everest to the miracles of modern technology, which gives us a real-time high-definition picture of the world. Also, Amit gives Ajay an exam. Can he pass? Can he? Whaddya think?
